finding.title: Verification opened the evidence store read-write
finding.consequence: A nominally observational integrity/status check opened SQLite in read-write mode, allowing recovery side effects and writable-file behavior at a frozen-log verification boundary.
finding.required_repair: Make public verification and status read-only by default while keeping explicit append/migration transactions writable.

nonclaim: Local connection-mode finding only; no actual evidence corruption is claimed.
